```{=html}
<section class="ux-dashboard-page" aria-labelledby="ux-dashboard-title">
  <h1 id="ux-dashboard-title" class="visually-hidden">Veronica Pletsch’s interactive UX dashboard</h1>
  <p id="ux-dashboard-status" class="visually-hidden" aria-live="polite">New message available.</p>

  <div class="ux-computer-stage" data-state="message">
    <img class="ux-computer-frame" src="images/ux-dashboard/computersemi_final.png" alt="Pink retro desktop computer">
    <div class="ux-screen" aria-label="Interactive retro desktop">
      <div class="ux-pink-desktop" aria-hidden="true"></div>

      <div class="ux-layer ux-message-notification">
        <img src="images/ux-dashboard/new_message.png" alt="New message: you have one new message">
        <button class="ux-hotspot ux-open-message" type="button" aria-label="Open new message"></button>
      </div>

      <div class="ux-layer ux-welcome-window" hidden>
        <img src="images/ux-dashboard/clippy_message.png" alt="Welcome to my web portfolio. Click through the computer folders to explore my work.">
        <button class="ux-pixel-button ux-start-loading" type="button" aria-label="OK, continue to the desktop"></button>
      </div>

      <div class="ux-layer ux-loading-window" hidden aria-hidden="true">
        <img src="images/ux-dashboard/loading_page.gif?animated=1" alt="Loading dashboard">
      </div>

      <div class="ux-layer ux-desktop-icons" hidden>
        <a class="ux-desktop-icon ux-projects" href="projects.html">
          <img src="images/ux-dashboard/blue_folder.png" alt="">
          <span>Projects</span>
        </a>
        <a class="ux-desktop-icon ux-ux-design" href="ux-design.html">
          <img src="images/ux-dashboard/paint_icon.png" alt="">
          <span>UX &amp; Product Design</span>
        </a>
        <a class="ux-desktop-icon ux-writing" href="writingsamplese.html">
          <img src="images/ux-dashboard/cd_icon.png" alt="">
          <span>Writing Samples</span>
        </a>
        <a class="ux-desktop-icon ux-presentations" href="presentations.html">
          <img src="images/ux-dashboard/blue_folder2.png" alt="">
          <span>Presentations</span>
        </a>
        <a class="ux-desktop-icon ux-resume" href="experience.html">
          <img src="images/ux-dashboard/coral_folder.png" alt="">
          <span>Resume</span>
        </a>
        <a class="ux-desktop-icon ux-home" href="index.html">
          <img src="images/ux-dashboard/internet_icon.png" alt="">
          <span>Home</span>
        </a>
        <a class="ux-desktop-icon ux-contact" href="contact.html">
          <img src="images/ux-dashboard/gear_icon.png" alt="">
          <span>Contact</span>
        </a>
      </div>

      <img id="ux-pixel-cursor" src="images/ux-dashboard/arrow_cursor.png" data-arrow="images/ux-dashboard/arrow_cursor.png" data-hand="images/ux-dashboard/hand_cursor.png" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
  (function () {
    const stage = document.querySelector('.ux-computer-stage');
    if (!stage) return;
    const screen = stage.querySelector('.ux-screen');
    const message = stage.querySelector('.ux-message-notification');
    const welcome = stage.querySelector('.ux-welcome-window');
    const loading = stage.querySelector('.ux-loading-window');
    const desktop = stage.querySelector('.ux-desktop-icons');
    const cursor = stage.querySelector('#ux-pixel-cursor');
    const status = document.querySelector('#ux-dashboard-status');
    const introStorageKey = 'veronicaPletschUxDesktopIntroSeen';

    function hasCompletedIntro() {
      try {
        return window.localStorage.getItem(introStorageKey) === 'true';
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    function rememberCompletedIntro() {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(introStorageKey, 'true');
      } catch (error) {
        // The dashboard still works when a browser blocks local storage.
      }
    }

    function setState(next) {
      stage.dataset.state = next;
      message.hidden = next !== 'message';
      welcome.hidden = next !== 'welcome';
      loading.hidden = next !== 'loading';
      loading.setAttribute('aria-hidden', next === 'loading' ? 'false' : 'true');
      desktop.hidden = next !== 'desktop';
      status.textContent = next === 'message' ? 'New message available.' : next === 'welcome' ? 'Welcome message open.' : next === 'loading' ? 'Loading dashboard.' : 'Desktop files are ready.';
    }

    setState(hasCompletedIntro() ? 'desktop' : 'message');

    stage.querySelector('.ux-open-message').addEventListener('click', function () { setState('welcome'); });
    stage.querySelector('.ux-start-loading').addEventListener('click', function () {
      setState('loading');
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        rememberCompletedIntro();
        setState('desktop');
      }, 3400);
    });
    screen.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
      if (event.pointerType === 'touch') return;
      const bounds = screen.getBoundingClientRect();
      cursor.style.left = ((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width * 100) + '%';
      cursor.style.top = ((event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height * 100) + '%';
      const isAction = event.target.closest('button, a');
      cursor.src = isAction ? cursor.dataset.hand : cursor.dataset.arrow;
      cursor.classList.toggle('is-hand', Boolean(isAction));
      cursor.classList.add('is-visible');
    });
    screen.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () {
      cursor.classList.remove('is-visible', 'is-hand');
      cursor.src = cursor.dataset.arrow;
    });
  }());
</script>
```
